findings.comment: 20-foot × 35-foot set-up area dimensions in front of transformer pads not documented with dimension lines on electrical plan or site plan. Visual layout suggests adequate space but specific 20 × 35 dimensions cannot be verified from submitted plans.

Pavement structural design calculations and load capacity verification (72,180 lbs total vehicle weight with 32,530 lbs maximum rear axle weight) not provided in submitted plans. Concrete drive surfaces are shown but supporting structural calculations are absent.

Storm sewer inlet locations are not explicitly mapped relative to transformer pad access points on submitted plans. Detailed overlay analysis would be required to confirm no inlets block curb access in front of transformer pads.

applicableAreas: electrical routing from transformers to meters
findings.comment: Detailed electrical conduit routing diagrams showing all 90-degree bend locations in transformer-to-meter conduit paths not provided. Electrical plan shows transformers, pull boxes, and meters but does not document the specific number of 90-degree bends in each routing branch, preventing verification of maximum 2-bend compliance.

Specific clearances between electrical routing and drainage infrastructure (storm drains, inlets, pipes) not documented. Minimum 12-inch clearance requirement cannot be verified without detailed overlay of conduit routing against drainage plan.

applicableAreas: electrical routing between transformer and meter
findings.comment: Electrical routing path overlay with recorded easement boundaries (including Water and Wastewater Vault Easement and property easements) not explicitly documented. Without detailed easement boundary mapping, cannot confirm 100% of electrical routing is on private property.

Exact distances from transformer pads to adjacent parking and traffic areas not dimensioned on plans. Bollard requirements are triggered when pads are within 4 feet of parking/traffic areas; without specific measurements, compliance cannot be verified.

Minimum 2-foot clearance from transformer pads to back of sidewalks not dimensioned on site plan or electrical plan. Sidewalks are shown immediately adjacent to transformer pad areas, but exact clearance distances are not documented.

Detailed routing of primary electrical conduit relative to building footprints not documented on electrical plan. Plans show general transformer, pull box, and meter locations but do not detail whether primary conduit routes under or over building structures.

Set-up area clearances and vertical clearance dimensions (20 ft × 35 ft with 35-foot vertical clearance) not documented on submitted plans. If set-up areas or clearances are reduced from standard requirements, documented Austin Energy Design approval would be required.
